When Dad asked me whether I fancied it, I said yes immediately. I wouldn't say going sailing was a dream of mine, and I didn't know whether I'd be able to do it. But sailing around the Greek islands, stopping at all the harbours sounded brilliant, and I couldn't wait. Before your holiday, did you do anything to prepare for going on a sailing boat? Mum said we should at least be able to identify and remember the names of all its different bits. The special words for the front and back and stuff. In the holiday programme today I'm talking to Joe Wilson, who's just been on a sailing holiday with his parents.
How did you first feel about this idea, Joe?
When Dad asked me whether I fancied it, I said yes immediately.
I wouldn't say going sailing was a dream of mine and I didn't know whether I'd be able to do it,
but sailing around the Greek islands, stopping at all the harbours sounded brilliant and I couldn't wait.

Anything to prepare for going on a sailing boat?

We didn't plan sightseeing because we weren't sure we'd have time.
You don't need to be especially strong for sailing, so there was no need to start going to the gym or anything.
How was the training?
It lasted a week.
I hadn't realised you could become a sailor in such a short time.
It was less complicated than I'd expected.
In the second week we managed our own boat.
We stayed in a group with other families on their boats and the instructors on theirs.
It made me feel safer going round the islands with them nearby.
What were you best at when sailing?
When you arrive at a harbour you have to be careful, otherwise you could damage the boat.
I got that right every time, though I can't say the same for keeping the boat going in the right direction.
I didn't crash into anything though.
And although I looked at the charts, they're maps that show how deep the water is, plus where rocks are.
My parents dealt with them.
Were there any storms?
Well one night there was a huge one which went on for hours.
Luckily we weren't out at sea when the lightning lit up the sky.
I couldn't believe the effect on the landscape.
The colours were gorgeous.
Seeing all the boats being knocked about in the wind was incredible.
Did you spend time on shore?
Yes, we often stopped and it was good to get off the boat before the trip.
I thought I'd go running whenever we were on land but there wasn't time.
But I did get to have a nice variety of tasty things to eat, most of which I'd never even heard of before.
I really enjoyed that.
I was hoping to chat to people, but I needed to know more Greek.
